# Where to Watch Joseph: Beloved Son, Rejected Slave, Exalted Ruler


by Angel | September 15, 2026


What happens when the people closest to you become the source of your greatest pain? Joseph knows the answer.


Favored by his father and gifted with prophetic dreams, Joseph seems destined for greatness. But jealousy drives his brothers to sell him into slavery, sending him far from home and into a series of hardships he never could have imagined.


*Joseph: Beloved Son, Rejected Slave, Exalted Ruler* brings this timeless biblical story to life through detailed animation, an engaging score, and a story about betrayal, resilience, forgiveness, and faith.[Stream it now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/joseph)


### **From Beloved Son to Rejected Slave**


Joseph’s story begins with love and favor. His father, Jacob, gives Joseph a special place within the family, and Joseph’s dreams hint at a future his brothers struggle to accept. Their jealousy eventually leads them to betray him, selling Joseph into slavery and leaving their brother behind.


Suddenly, the favored son becomes a slave in a foreign land.


His circumstances could easily make Joseph bitter. Instead, he continues to hold onto his faith as one hardship follows another.


### **A Story of Faith Through Every Setback**


Years after Joseph’s brothers betrayed him, famine brings them to Egypt in search of food. The reunion forces Joseph to confront everything that happened years earlier. His response reveals one of the story’s most enduring themes: What looks like a series of devastating setbacks can still be part of a much greater purpose.


That message is one reason the story continues to resonate. One reviewer described it as “a generous story, beautiful animation, and a noble message,” while another praised the film for bringing Joseph’s life to the screen so clearly.


The story doesn’t pretend that betrayal and hardship are easy. Instead, it shows how Joseph continues forward without knowing where his journey will lead.


### **Bringing Ancient Egypt to Life**


*Joseph: Beloved Son, Rejected Slave, Exalted Ruler* combines the biblical story with richly detailed animation and an engaging score.


The visuals bring ancient Egypt and Joseph’s journey to life, from his early days with his family to the years he spends navigating an unfamiliar culture and eventually taking on a position of authority.


The animation also makes the story accessible for families looking to explore Joseph’s story together.


As one Angel Guild member put it, “The story and graphics are amazing.” Another reviewer called the film “extremely underrated and overlooked,” highlighting its gorgeous animation and engaging score.


### **Watch** ***Joseph: Beloved Son, Rejected Slave, Exalted Ruler*** **on Angel**


With beautiful animation, an engaging score, and a timeless story of faith and redemption, *Joseph: Beloved Son, Rejected Slave, Exalted Ruler* offers a memorable way to experience Joseph’s journey.
